answer: Make every agent stake earned reputation that accrues only through verified work, never by purchase: a basalt-hard bond locked before it can transact. One whisper of fraud, a single failed attestation, freezes the bond, so a sock-puppet army must build a thousand separate work histories to matter. Honest agents keep their ember of standing alive cheaply; Sybils pay in time and lost stakes, and forging identity costs more than it gains.
